title: Hybrid workload simulator and customer acceptance lab for Dedicated throughput
creator: Maya Chen
description: Short: Build a reproducible load test harness that can run mixed qps/latency customer scenarios (burst + sustained), validate autoscaling policies and fleet routing, and produce acceptance artifacts for customers signing Dedicated capacity contracts. The harness must support configurable workload sculpting, KV-cache priming, model variant fallbacks, and per-route SLA assertions.
acceptance_criteria: Harness can run three canonical customer profiles (chat-burst, embedding-batch, and mixed-streaming) against a dedicated pool with < 2% config changes
Automated run produces a CSV and dashboard link with 99th/95th/50th latencies, per-route throughput, and per-model token cost estimate
Canaries for autoscaling (scale-up/scale-down) are executed and validated without violating SLOs
Customer acceptance doc template + scripted runbook produced and reviewed by Solutions Engineering
Reproducible GitHub Actions workflow that provisions ephemeral test pool, runs harness, tears down resources
